workload.query_validation: all 10000 query records must contain finite Float32 values

v2_block_mapping.endpoint_1000000_provenance: approved carry-forward; not independently tuned for N=1000000

sampling.run_order: construction first; four lanes rotate by (workload_ordinal+iteration) mod 4

timing_boundaries.CPU-E2E-RAW: CPU Float32 production call entry through synchronous host result return; loaded data/query already available
timing_boundaries.BND-KERNEL: CUDA events around the complete V2 production kernel sequence with device-resident dataset, query, result and workspace
timing_boundaries.BND-E2E-RAW: V2 raw one-shot validation, conversion, transient allocation, transfers, kernels, synchronization and call-owned cleanup
timing_boundaries.BND-E2E-PREP: V2 prepared synchronous per-query validation, transfer, kernels, result transfer, synchronization and per-search cleanup; persistent construction/destruction excluded
timing_boundaries.COST-PREP-DATASET-CONSTRUCTION: prepared dataset API call; persistent destruction excluded
timing_boundaries.COST-V2-WORKSPACE-CONSTRUCTION: V2 workspace API call; persistent destruction excluded
timing_boundaries.COST-PREPARED-READY-CONSTRUCTION: dataset preparation entry through workspace construction return; persistent destruction excluded

ratio_rule.universal_inconclusive: none rejected and at least one inconclusive

environment_policy.incomplete_or_contaminated_action: retain samples and force performance interpretations inconclusive
